title: HTML Performance
summary: Page weight kills performance: images dominate bytes, render-blocking CSS/JS delays first paint, and too many DOM nodes slow everything.
learningObjectives: Apply the concept in a small program
Predict program output by reading code

sections.content: Page weight kills performance: images dominate bytes, render-blocking CSS/JS delays first paint, and too many DOM nodes slow everything.
Fixes: lazy-load off-screen media, defer non-critical scripts, inline critical CSS, subset fonts, and keep DOM shallow. Measure with Lighthouse before optimizing.
Key points: preload key assets, avoid layout-thrashing JS, and HTTP/2+ makes many small files cheap — but bytes still matter on mobile.

sections.codeExample:
<link rel="preload" href="font.woff2" as="font" type="font/woff2">
<script src="app.js" defer></script>
